_comment: THE THEME REGISTER — PREREG_UNIVERSE_CURATION §11 Rule 0. The recorded hypothesis layer: operator-authored falsifiable theses + named deterministic sources + default cluster routing + provenance. NEVER loaded by the trading loop (config.universe.themes stays the loop-facing basket; this file is the auditable rule artifact + per-window admission record). Changes = dated operator amendments. provenance: 'operator' | 'generated' (reserved, PREREG_THEME_GENERATION_STUB.md).

nuclear_fuel.thesis: Global reactor life-extensions/restarts + the SMR pipeline outrun the uranium fuel cycle's mine + conversion/enrichment capacity; fuel-chain and reactor-tech names reprice before the buildout is consensus-priced.
nuclear_fuel.falsifier: Mine/enrichment capacity additions clear demand without sustained term-price escalation; SMR pipeline stalls (cancellations outpace orders).

grid_equipment.thesis: AI-datacenter interconnection demand outruns grid electrical-equipment supply (transformers, conduit, storage, superconductors), pushing multi-year backlogs at second-order suppliers the buildout narrative under-covers.
grid_equipment.falsifier: Equipment lead times normalize / datacenter capex digestion; backlogs shrink for 2+ consecutive quarters.
sources: GRID constituent file (ftportfolios.com etfholdings GRID, fetched 2026-06-09)

copper_supply.thesis: Electrification + grid/datacenter buildout copper demand against structurally constrained mine supply (the themes.json FCX hand-seed thesis, extended to the supply-chain basket).
copper_supply.falsifier: Mine supply growth or substitution closes the deficit; copper term structure stays flat through the buildout.

space_smallcap.thesis: Launch-cost deflation expands constellation / in-space-services demand faster than small-cap space revenue is priced; the primes are consensus, the small-cap supply chain is not.
space_smallcap.falsifier: Launch cadence or constellation capex stalls; small-cap space revenue misses compound for 2+ quarters.

silver_deficit.thesis: A structural silver supply deficit — industrial + solar (PV) demand outrunning constrained primary mine supply and falling above-ground stocks — drives sustained higher realized silver prices for primary silver producers; the deficit is under-narrated relative to gold/precious-metals coverage.
silver_deficit.falsifier: Mine supply growth, recycling, or demand substitution closes the deficit; silver fails to escalate through 2+ consecutive deficit-year prints.

seaborne_freight.falsifier: Newbuild deliveries / demand softening loosen freight rates; spot rates fall for 2+ consecutive quarters against the orderbook thesis.

Inflection leg = RPO/capex re-acceleration in the filed quarterlies (the operator's 2026-07-07 watch trigger).
refrigerant_transition.falsifier: No RPO or capex re-acceleration in any filed quarterly through the FY-2026 report (filed ~Feb-2027) — the turn never forms, theme dies. (Draft-dated under the operator's admission delegation — the 2026-07-07 falsifier-pin precedent.)

mrna_oncology.thesis: The Moderna+Merck intismeran Phase 3 melanoma win (2026-08-19) is the first pivotal validation of individualized neoantigen therapy (INT) — a platform event, not a single-drug event: intismeran runs multiple Phase 2/3 trials in other tumors, BioNTech runs the rival program, and every patient-individualized dose requires tumor sequencing + rapid mRNA synthesis + bioprocess capacity. Second-order expression (copper-not-rockets): the platform's commercialization economics and picks-and-shovels layer rather than the repriced headline name. MRK is the admitted expression — ~50/50 intismeran economics plus the under-narrated angle that INT success extends the Keytruda franchise past its ~2028 LOE cliff. MRNA itself is EXCLUDED as already-priced (+177% on the readout — premise-currency Rule 5).
mrna_oncology.falsifier: By ~Aug-2027, INT progress must show BOTH (a) a regulatory milestone for intismeran in melanoma (filing/approval) AND (b) measurable order/revenue acceleration at the supply layer (mRNA raw materials, sequencing-partner volumes) in filed reports. Neither = theme dies. Sympathy-repriced names fail premise-currency at any future admission. (Draft-dated under the operator's admission delegation — the 2026-07-07 falsifier-pin precedent.)

ag_cycle_trough.thesis: Ag equipment/inputs cycle trough: two years of farm-income recession have compressed dealer inventories, aged the working fleet, and cut nutrient application below agronomic norms — a mean-reversion setup with a structural floor (fleet age + soil-nutrient draw-down are not narratives, they are inventories that must eventually restock). TITN (equipment dealer — the highest-torque cycle expression) + MOS (phosphate/potash — application recovery + supply-side discipline). PINNED HONESTLY: this is a TURNAROUND-CLASS thesis, ranked LAST of the five adopted on mandate fit — it self-falsifies by success (the rally that proves the turn IS the already-priced state; premise-currency Rule 5 applies at every future window) and cycle-watching analyst coverage makes under_narrated the council's binding question, not ours.
ag_cycle_trough.falsifier: By ~Aug-2027, the filed record must show equipment orders/dealer-inventory normalization (TITN same-store sales/inventory turns inflecting) or nutrient volume/price recovery (MOS shipment volumes) in quarterlies. A prolonged farm-income recession through the FY-2027 mid-year reports with no order inflection = theme dies. (Draft-dated under the operator's admission delegation — the 2026-07-07 falsifier-pin precedent.)

design_software_ai.thesis: AI-native design/collaboration platform whose fundamentals are RE-ACCELERATING while the stock has round-tripped its IPO froth (2025 IPO at $33 → >$120 → ~$23 today, ~−80% from the peak). Q2-2026 revenue $370.1M +48% y/y — the third straight quarter of accelerating growth — on the first full quarter of AI-credit monetization; net dollar retention 136%; FY-2026 guidance raised to $1.463–1.467B (+39% at the midpoint); Q3 guide +36%; gross-profit growth accelerated to 40% (company release 2026-08-05). The price/fundamentals divergence — a busted-IPO tape on an accelerating business — is the convexity setup; software re-rates discontinuously when re-acceleration is believed. PINNED CAVEATS (this is NOT a copper-not-rockets name): heavily narrated — under_narrated will very likely FAIL at the council (the MRK/KKR precedent; that is the seam working, not a reason to skip admission); the growth base is AI-credit add-ons of unproven durability; SBC-heavy; lock-up/secondary supply. Admission is feasibility-only — cheapness and momentum are forbidden criteria; the council judges.
design_software_ai.falsifier: Q3-2026 (reported ~Nov-2026) revenue growth < 30% y/y, or net dollar retention < 120% = the re-acceleration story is over. (AI-drafted 2026-09-06 under the operator's admission delegation, operator-adopted by the 09-06 word — the 2026-07-07 falsifier-pin precedent.)

bnpl_payments.thesis: A consumer-payments / BNPL network whose top line is compounding while the equity has been de-rated as a busted 2025 IPO. FY-2025 revenue $3,509M vs $2,811M, +24.8% y/y (annual filing, period 2025-12-31, filed 2026-02-26 — the only filed-XBRL line in the corpus for this name so far). Trailing return −69.8% over 12 months / −27.7% over the last month against that growth is the price/fundamentals divergence the mandate looks for: a payments network with merchant-side scale re-rates discontinuously when growth durability is believed. PINNED CAVEATS: (1) ONE fundamentals line in the corpus — the council grounds on markers + this line until 10-Q coverage fills, so under_narrated/at_inflection may fail for evidence-thinness rather than on the merits (a datum about the seam, as with FIG/MRK); (2) BNPL is a credit business in a consumer-credit cycle — losses, funding cost and regulation are the exogenous risks a network framing understates; (3) heavy post-IPO sponsor/insider supply; (4) the reach card's own draft leaned on 'cheap participation ($142 vs $1,000)' — STRUCK: cheapness is the IV gate's job and is FORBIDDEN as an admission criterion; admission is feasibility-only.
bnpl_payments.falsifier: The first quarterly report dated after 2026-09-13 shows quarterly revenue growth below +10% y/y.

live_events_marketplace.thesis: A two-sided live-events marketplace whose volume keeps compounding while the equity has round-tripped its 2025 IPO. Quarterly revenue $573.1M, +33.2% y/y (period 2026-06-30, filed 2026-08-13), against a −73.1% twelve-month price return and −14.7% over the last month. Marketplace economics are convex when they turn: fixed platform cost against take-rate on rising volume, so the market's re-rating of a marketplace it has written off is discontinuous rather than gradual. The price/fundamentals divergence is the convexity setup. PINNED CAVEATS: (1) a −73% tape is INFORMATION, not only sentiment — the market may be pricing take-rate compression, the competitive squeeze from Ticketmaster/SeatGeek, or regulatory attention to ticketing fees, none of which the revenue line refutes; (2) live events are consumer discretionary, so the thesis carries a cycle risk the growth number does not show; (3) ONE filed quarter in the corpus and no analyst count — an evidence-thin council read is expected and is a datum about the seam, not a verdict (the FIG/MRK/KLAR precedent); (4) post-IPO insider supply.
live_events_marketplace.falsifier: The quarter reported after 2026-09-30 shows revenue growth below +10% y/y.
